\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{patterns}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\fill[green!15] (-.1,-.1) rectangle (4.3,2.3);
\fill[pattern=fivepointed stars,pattern color=red] (0,1.2) rectangle (2,2.2);
\path[even odd rule,pattern=sixpointed stars,pattern color=blue] (2.2,1.2) rectangle (4.2,2.2);
\fill[pattern=bricks,pattern color=black] (0,0) rectangle (2,1);
\path[pattern=checkerboard,pattern color=violet,fill opacity=.55] (2.2,0) rectangle (4.2,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
